## Summary

What does this pull request change, and why? Link the related issue (for example "Closes #12").

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`python -m pytest`) and new behavior is covered by a test that runs on CPU without private data.
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] The documentation builds (`sphinx-build -b html docs docs/_build/html`) and is updated where needed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under "Unreleased".
- [ ] Default settings that reproduce published results are unchanged, or the change is explained above.
- [ ] No data, model weights, results or absolute local paths are added.
